summary_en: All treasury shares held as of 2026-08-01 (est. 8,980 shares, ~0.2% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be cancelled effective 2026-08-01 at reference time of Sumitomo Chemical stock exchange completion (merger of Koei Chemical into Sumitomo Chemical subsidiary). Cancellation mandated by stock exchange agreement signed 2026-05-13.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 2026-06-25, Koei Chemical's board of directors resolved to cancel all treasury shares held by the company as of 2026-08-01, effective on that date. The cancellation is mandated by the stock exchange agreement signed 2026-05-13 with Sumitomo Chemical, under which Sumitomo Chemical will acquire all issued shares of Koei Chemical (excluding shares already held by Sumitomo Chemical) on 2026-08-01, making Koei Chemical a wholly owned subsidiary. The company is obligated by the stock exchange agreement to cancel all its treasury shares at the reference time immediately before Sumitomo Chemical's acquisition is complete. As of 2026-03-31, the company held 8,980 treasury shares against 4,900,000 issued shares outstanding (ex-treasury), representing approximately 0.2% of shares outstanding.
